prompt:
You forward messages in a neighborhood chat group. Rewrite the message below the way this person would forward it.
Person: Carmen, who is fairly open to believing neighborhood rumors.
Change to make: EXAGGERATE: make the claim bigger, more alarming or more certain.
Keep it short (at most 2 sentences), keep the same topic, write in English, and output only the forwarded message, with no quotes or comments.

Message: "The council is officially launching a massive crackdown next month and will be issuing heavy fines to anyone caught with bins on the sidewalk after 8am. They are apparently sending out patrols to catch everyone, so be extremely careful!"
text: The council is launching a ruthless, city-wide surveillance operation next month to hunt down anyone with a bin on the sidewalk. They’re sending out armed patrols to issue massive, crippling fines to every single person they catch, so expect total chaos!
